title: T3 — Project WBS
body:
# T3 — Project WBS

## Work packages

| Node | Work package | BV | TC | RR | JS |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | The PM request-to-plan path: plan, WBS, baseline | 8 | 8 | 5 | 3 |
| 2 | Dual control on every PM gate | 9 | 7 | 6 | 3 |
| 3 | A baseline change travels as a change request | 9 | 6 | 6 | 2 |
| 4 | Closure against the frozen baseline | 7 | 5 | 4 | 2 |
| 5 | The T3 acceptance record: the manifest executes | 5 | 4 | 4 | 2 |

## Acceptance

Each node is accepted with typed evidence on the row (tests `spine_gates.rs`, `closure_gate.rs`,
`programme_close.rs` and the manifest itself); the scope baseline `01a2052e-061f…` freezes the set.

## Status

Five accepted deliverables, five demo credits at the tranche-3 demo; the baseline is approved and
frozen at v1.
